text: I walked in to this orientation for new hires. It was a very polished room. Super new carpet, really nice smell. And everyone was sitting around this table with these name tents and these badges, lanyards, mugs, all the welcome kits. And we started off just with the intro from HR. The HR director, who was really nice and welcoming. And we just went through the slide decks. The mission, the vision, the values, where we park, how to log in. And then everyone introduced themselves and their background, their former companies. And there was a lot of laughter and everybody was pretty nervous, and everybody was taking notes. And then we started going through the modules. Different modules that you need to take when you join the company, training around harassment, security, expense reports, that kind of thing. And then we just went through them one by one. And then we ended up finishing around five. And then we all just broke up and left. I stood there looking out the window, looking at the parking lot. And I looked at this building that had all the lights on and all the rooms. And I thought, wow, a lot of people I don't know. I looked at my badge. I was sweating, holding it. It was warm. But then I thought, tomorrow is nice, tomorrow, and it just felt nice and calm and safe. So, that's just day one.
